name: World
description: An open world: one scene made of many sections (villages, towns, camps, castles, dungeons and the wild land between), planned whole first so that its roads, rivers, coasts and forests run on across them (docs/places/tiling.md).

sites.description: its settled places: villages, towns, camps, castles, dungeon entrances; each a section

landform.description: the shape of the land: inland, a coast along one side, an island, an archipelago, a peninsula

relief.description: the lie of the land: level, low rolling hills, high ground, or mountain ranges

woods.description: how wooded the wild land is

spacing.description: how far apart its settlements are, 1 to 10: the empty land between two, in small settlements' widths (1: close neighbours; 3: a few villages' width of open country between them; 9: far apart, long roads), whatever their own size; from the request's words ("close together", "far apart", "remote")

settlementSize.description: how big its settlements are, unless a place says otherwise (its build type's sizes: a village, a large village, a town, a city)

links.description: one road network for the whole world, joining its settled places (their build type's reachedByRoad): each to the main road or to the nearest one on it, and to its nearest neighbour, each road running into the place to its middle

compile.sharesDescription: each part's least share of the world, whatever the plan says: the sea, the mountains and the forests big enough to read
compile.exitsDescription: roads leading out over the world's border from these edges (n, s, w, e) to its main road
compile.roadsAfterLandDescription: the main road is laid once the land is (round the sea and the lakes, ending at the shore where a way in is in the sea); the land is laid before the places, which take spread points of the open land left
compile.bordersDescription: what decorates the world's edges (each module: how many, growing in from the border: at-edge), unless the Brief turns that module off; border woods are painted with the world's land, the range is mountains like any other
